author: Epic Games
description:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins. https://epic.gm/ffvii-revelation

A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.
title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION | Reveal Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Solve the neon-noir mystery of who killed Zane's Digi-Clone, hunt down a new Pearlescent weapon and 6 new pieces of Legendary loot, and 24 cosmetic items and 4 pieces of rerollable Legendary gear with Vault Card 3! https://epic.gm/borderlands4

Both Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill for and Bounty Pack 3: Vault Card 3 are now available. Starting with Bounty Pack 3, we're releasing DLC in two distinct parts that you can purchase individually.

Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill For includes: 
New mission featuring a new boss and 2 new mini-bosses that can drop a new Pearlescent weapon and 6 new pieces of Legendary loot! Unravel the mystery of who killed Zane's Digi-Clone in this repeatable mission focused on everyone's favorite hitman turned Vault Hunter. Complete the mission to score new rewards: a Vault Hunter Skin usable by all Vault Hunters, a Vehicle, and an ECHO-4 Drone Skin.  

Bounty Pack 3: Vault Card 3 includes:
4 rerollable pieces of Legendary gear, 4 Vault Hunter Heads usable by all
title: Borderlands 4 - Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill For | Official Reveal Trailer
